table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	POCode = H.POCode,
	Date = H.Date,
	Remarks = H.Remarks,
	SuppCode = H.SuppCode,
	SuppAliasName = A.AliasName,
	SupplierName = A.Name,
	ICode = D.ICode,
	AliasName = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	Manufacturer = M.Name,
	POQty = ISNULL(SUM(D.Qty), 0),
	POBonus = ISNULL(SUM(D.BonusQty), 0),
	PurQty = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(PD.PackQty + PD.LooseQty) FROM PurDetail PD , PurLedger PL 
		WHERE PL.POCode = H.POCode AND PL.PurInvCode = PD.PurInvCode AND PD.ICode=D.ICode),0),
	PurBonus = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(PD.BonusQty) FROM PurDetail PD , PurLedger PL 
		WHERE PL.POCode = H.POCode AND PL.PurInvCode = PD.PurInvCode AND PD.ICode=D.ICode),0)
FROM
	PurOrderDetail D,
	PurOrderHeader H,
	Supplier S,
	Accounts A,
	Item I,
	Manufacturer M
WHERE
	H.POCode IN (:ai_pocode) AND
	H.SuppCode = S.SuppCode AND
	S.SuppCode = A.AccCode AND
	H.POCode = D.POCode AND
	D.ICode=I.ICode AND
	I.ManfCode = M.ManfCode
GROUP BY
	H.POCode,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	H.Date,
	H.Remarks,
	H.SuppCode,
	D.ICode,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,
	M.Name
table.sort: suppliername A, pocode A, itemname A
